svg.title: Two-color guide and science paths through a common corrector — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: A real 589 nm guide source and 800 nm science source are combined onto a native DM, then separated by wavelength to two cameras. The common correction can be adjusted against the guide image. The native bench constructs shared correction and spectral guide/science separation. It does not simulate a sodium beacon, finite-altitude cone effect, absolute tip/tilt recovery or atmospheric wavefront sensing.
